audience: community managers and hosts who run a Mighty Networks community

useCases.title: Compare the member count of each space
useCases.text: List the spaces of the network with their titles, URLs and member counts. Open one space for its creation date and archived flag.

useCases.title: Review recent posts and their comments
useCases.text: List the posts of one space, newest first, with comment counts. Read one post, then its comments, including the replies.

useCases.title: Check upcoming events and RSVP counts
useCases.text: List upcoming or past events, optionally for one space, with their start times and RSVP counts.

useCases.title: Look up members by role
useCases.text: List members, filtered by role or member type, with their join dates and last activity. Member emails are not returned.

useCases.title: Draft a post for review before it goes live
useCases.text: Create a post in a space. It stays a draft, which members cannot see, until it is set to posted. Members get no notice by default.

useCases.title: Reply to a member comment
useCases.text: Read the comments on a post. Add a comment as the host, or pass a comment id to reply inside a thread.
